entrypoints.installer: Configure the host runtime to invoke the command for each exposed lifecycle hook.

limitations: This publisher is self-attested and has not run an upstream AgentHook conformance fixture.
Coverage depends on the host runtime invoking the configured hook; an unhooked execution route is outside this publisher's visibility.
The local receipt chain is tamper-evident after capture, not a remote timestamp, signature, or hardware attestation.
SessionEnd is translated from the host-native Stop event; AgentHandoff is translated from subagent lifecycle events.

commands: python -m ruff check scripts/system/scbe_hook_router.py scripts/system/scbe_tool_context.py tests/system/test_scbe_hook_router.py tests/system/test_scbe_tool_context.py
